category_title: Ninth-grade students labeled as struggling readers who engage through inquiry-based disciplinary literacy
minimal_context: The student is listening to a 10-minute lecture on imperialism and the U.S. annexation of Hawai'i while the 'Petition Against Annexation' is displayed on the document camera.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's begin our 10-minute lecture on imperialism and the U.S. annexation of Hawai'i. I have the 1897 'Petition Against Annexation' on the document camera, so please take notes as I talk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Coughs and pulls her gray sweatshirt tighter, staring blankly at the document camera without picking up her pencil.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please make sure you are following along with the lecture.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Leans back in her chair, appearing tired, and still does not take any notes.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is important to get this information down.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Coughs again and rests her head on her hand, completely unengaged with the lecture and leaving her paper blank.)
